info.name: Missing Subresource Integrity
author: lucky0x0d
pulsesecurity.co.nz
sullo amarsct
info.description: Checks if external script and stylesheet tags in the HTML response are missing the Subresource Integrity (SRI) attribute.

curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0, Win64, x64, rv:139.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/139.0' 'https://www.venturecapitalopportunitiesfund.com.au/'
